an5.138:1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo bhattādako ca hoti okāsapharaṇo ca laṇḍusādhano ca salākaggāhī ca rañño nāgotveva saṃkhaṃ gacchati
an5.138:1.3: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti rūpānaṃ akkhamo saddānaṃ akkhamo gandhānaṃ akkhamo rasānaṃ akkhamo phoṭṭhabbānaṃ
an5.138:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo bhattādako ca hoti okāsapharaṇo ca laṇḍusādhano ca salākaggāhī ca rañño nāgotveva saṃkhaṃ gacchati
an5.138:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhattādako ca hoti okāsapharaṇo ca pīṭhamaddano ca salākaggāhī ca bhikkhutveva saṃkhaṃ gacchati
an5.138:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti rūpānaṃ akkhamo saddānaṃ akkhamo gandhānaṃ akkhamo rasānaṃ akkhamo phoṭṭhabbānaṃ
an5.138:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhattādako ca hoti okāsapharaṇo ca pīṭhamaddano ca salākaggāhī ca bhikkhutveva saṃkhaṃ gacchatīti.
